name: Memory (YantrikDB)
description: YantrikDB-backed long-term memory: semantic recall with retrieval reasons, conflict-aware session briefings, auto-capture. Talks to a YantrikDB server over HTTP only.

baseUrl.description: YantrikDB HTTP gateway URL. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:7438 (or YANTRIKDB_URL).

apiKey.description: Bearer token for the YantrikDB gateway. Falls back to YANTRIKDB_API_KEY.

namespace.description: Namespace that scopes this agent's memories inside YantrikDB. Default: openclaw.

domain.description: Default domain tag for stored memories. Default: general.

autoRecall.description: Inject a memory briefing into the prompt at session start. Default: true.

autoCapture.description: Capture durable facts from conversations automatically. Default: true.

injectSessionDigest.description: Use YantrikDB's session digest (open decisions, unresolved conflicts, pending triggers) as the boot briefing. Default: true.

recallLimit.description: Default number of results for memory_recall. Default: 5.

captureImportance.description: Importance assigned to auto-captured memories. Default: 0.4.

maxContextChars.description: Upper bound on injected briefing size. Default: 2400.
